changes: The existing KDA and NoPE MLA components accept caller-supplied parameter Values; deterministic test initialization calls the same math append.
Each append borrows its operands and returns ports; the caller retains source/storage ownership and complete StateHead publication.
Cold validation respects BF16 [N,K], original F32/GGUF MatMul [K,N], grouped [H,N,K], plain F32 state and supplied decay encoding.

properties.supplied_parameter_scope: Original-geometry BF16, non-square F32 and GGUF parameter inputs are descriptors only; no numeric weight buffers, source payload or native work. Both appends consume these actual Values; no seed factory.

properties.weight_scope: Generated sparse BF16/F32 weights at fixed Kimi7168/96x128 geometry; NOT original artifact payload or quality
properties.composition_scope: Actual KDA hidden lease feeds actual absorbed MLA. Intervening full model layers/residuals and LM head are not executed; no generated token or MTP claim.
properties.state_scope: One StateStore, two independent Heads and one immutable restored fork; convolution history, recurrent KDA, full finite MLA cache, actual Graph I32 cursor, actual final feature, Epoch metadata. AttnRes is frame-only and absent.
properties.native_cancellation_scope: Cancellation is of the unpublished StateDraft after KDA has actually retired; no GPU preemption claim

review: Independent review found the draft layout bug before compiling; it and plain-state validation were corrected before the recorded finite checks. Review record is archived.
